messages.body_plain:
Hi everyone,

We've just found that there's an issue with the implementation of conduction in the endotherm model. We're in the process of resolving it. By default, conduction is not invoked, but if you were using it with the parameter pcond set to > 0 you should for now set it back to zero.

Sorry for any hassles.

All the best,
Mike

Jonathan
